name: Website assistant
outcome: Customers get a correct answer to a policy or product question without waiting for an agent.
metric: Share of website questions answered correctly with no agent contact within 7 days

name: Reply drafts for agents
outcome: Agents answer policy and product questions faster without more mistakes.
metric: Median handling time on policy and product contacts, with the error rate found in quality review held level

name: Warranty claim triage
outcome: Each warranty claim reaches the team that can settle it on the first attempt.
metric: Share of claims routed correctly first time, and median days from claim to decision

name: Safety signal screening
outcome: Every contact that describes a fire, smoke or shock incident reaches the safety team the same day.
metric: Share of confirmed incidents flagged within one working day, and flags per confirmed incident

name: Automatic refund approval
outcome: Customers entitled to a refund get it within two working days.
metric: Share of eligible refunds paid within two working days
redirect: Rules over the order records, written from the returns policy. A model may read a free-text return reason, with a person deciding.

name: Library consistency check
outcome: No support article contradicts a current policy.
metric: Share of the 300 support articles consistent with the current policies, checked each month

name: Call and chat summaries
outcome: Agents spend less time writing up contacts, and the next agent can see what happened.
metric: Minutes of wrap-up time per contact, with summary accuracy checked by sampling

name: Spare parts demand forecast
outcome: Engineers have the part they need on the first visit.
metric: First-visit fix rate, and stock-outs per month across the 1,800 part numbers
redirect: A forecasting model over parts usage history, or a demand planning product.
